title: Tokimeki Memorial: Forever with You
native_title: ときめき メモリアル ～ｆｏｒｅｖｅｒ ｗｉｔｈ ｙｏｕ～
overview:
Live out three years of high school in this dating simulation. Each weekend you plan your schedule - studying different subjects, exercising, resting or calling friends on the phone - and every choice shapes your stats, the events of the week and which girls you meet.

Ask girls out on dates and pick the right answers to win their hearts, but take care: each girl has her own personality and circle of friends, and how she feels about you spreads to them too. Join a school club to boost your abilities and open up extra content, including mini-games. For the inside scoop on the girls, turn to the ever-informed Yoshio Saotome.

- New system that lets you make the confession yourself
- Watch for the bomb icon in your contact book, a sign of strong feelings
- Shuttle Mouse and backup memory supported
